note: Each wasm build profile's gzipped size, held by `cargo xtask footprint
--profile NAME --gzipped BYTES --run REV@HOST --date DAY`. A local run
builds the profile as release.yml's npm job builds the wasm, under the
job's `RUSTFLAGS`, `-D warnings` and the `--remap-path-prefix` flags
`cargo xtask remap-paths` prints, so the wasm names no path of the
machine: `wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir pkg
bindings/js`, followed by `-- --features bundled-fonts` or `-- --features
cjk-fonts` for those profiles, counts `gzip -9 -c
bindings/js/pkg/tinker_pdf_js_bg.wasm | wc -c` and passes the number in.
Each feature `bindings/js/Cargo.toml` forwards beside `cmap-predefined`
is a profile of its own name. A size over `figure.bytes` plus
`tolerance.bytes` fails; a shrink passes and prints the `--record` line
that writes it as the figure, with its run and day, keeping the
tolerance. A profile with no entry fails unless the run names it
`--unrecorded`.
`figure` is one run's measurement: `bytes`, the `date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and
the `run`, `<revision>@<host>`, the commit it built and the target triple
of the host that built it, with `#<n>` for the nth build of one revision
on one host. `tolerance` is measured, never assumed: `bytes` is the
widest spread of one revision's size over the `runs` it names, five clean
builds and one more under the previous stable toolchain, and `toolchains`
names the compilers they built with; zero is a measurement too. A clean
build deletes `target/wasm32-unknown-unknown` and `bindings/js/pkg`
first, so each compiles the revision anew. `cargo xtask check` refuses
an entry missing any of these, or carrying a key nothing reads.
The binding is a member of the root workspace (ruling 25), so a
revision's wasm is the same bytes from any checkout path. A profile's
first figure and tolerance are written by hand from its runs; `--record`
only moves a figure whose tolerance it keeps.
